cards.title: Career & Journey

cards.title: Education & Skills
cards.description: BSc in Mathematics (8.28, 3rd of Class) & BSc in Physics (8.35, 3rd of Class), MSc Plasma Physics (1st of Class), Skills & Parallel HPC runtime stack, Slurm orchestration, After Effects, and deployment experience across MareNostrum 5 (MN5), Leonardo, and LUMI.

cards.title: Creative Computing
